title: Database Foundation
description: Establish the global Kysely database connection, define all table types, and create the complete initial PostgreSQL schema in a single migration.
acceptance_criteria: DatabaseModule is decorated with @Global() and exports DatabaseService
DatabaseService extends Kysely<Database> and connects using process.env.DATABASE_URL
types.ts defines Database interface including tables: organizations, users, projects, tasks — every table except organizations includes tenant_id: string (NOT Generated<string>)
Generated<> is used ONLY for: id, created_at, updated_at, is_active columns
users.role type is union 'Admin' | 'ProjectManager' | 'Member'
projects.status type is union 'Active' | 'Archived'
tasks.status type is union 'ToDo' | 'InProgress' | 'Completed'

001_initial.ts creates organizations, users, projects, tasks tables with all columns, CHECK constraints, foreign keys, ON DELETE CASCADE rules, and required indexes exactly as defined in the specification
users.email has UNIQUE constraint and idx_users_tenant_id index exists
projects has idx_projects_tenant_id and idx_projects_status indexes
tasks has idx_tasks_tenant_id, idx_tasks_project_id, idx_tasks_assignee_id, idx_tasks_status indexes
migrate.ts runs all pending migrations programmatically using Kysely Migrator
app.module.ts imports DatabaseModule

title: Authentication Module
description: Implement JWT authentication with register, login, refresh token, global guard, and role-based decorators.
acceptance_criteria: AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/register decorated with @Public()
RegisterDto has email, password, first_name, last_name with exact validation rules and does NOT include role field
POST /api/auth/register hashes password using bcrypt with 12 salt rounds and always sets role to 'Member'
POST /api/auth/register returns { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id }
POST /api/auth/register throws ConflictException if email already exists
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/login decorated with @Public()
POST /api/auth/login returns { access_token, refresh_token, user: { id, email, first_name, last_name, role, tenant_id } }
Login throws BadRequestException for invalid credentials and UnauthorizedException if is_active is false
AuthController exposes POST /api/auth/refresh decorated with @Public() and returns new access_token
jwt.strategy.ts validate() returns { id, email, role, tenant_id } using payload.sub
Global JWT guard is registered using APP_GUARD and controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
@Public() decorator bypasses global guard
@Roles(...roles) decorator stores metadata and RolesGuard enforces exact role string comparison
app.module.ts imports AuthModule

title: Organizations Module
description: Allow creation of a new organization along with its first Admin user and return an access token.
acceptance_criteria: OrganizationsController exposes POST /api/organizations decorated with @Public()
CreateOrganizationDto has name, email, password, first_name, last_name with validation rules
POST /api/organizations creates organization row and first user with role 'Admin' and tenant_id equal to organization id
Password is hashed with bcrypt 12 rounds
Email must be globally unique else throw ConflictException
Response returns { access_token, user: { id, email, first_name, last_name, role: 'Admin', tenant_id } }
controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports OrganizationsModule

title: Users Module
description: Provide Admin-only user listing and role management within the same tenant.
acceptance_criteria: UsersController exposes GET /api/users?page=1&limit=20 with @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/users returns { data: User[], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
GET /api/users queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
UsersController exposes PATCH /api/users/:id/role with @Roles('Admin')
UpdateUserRoleDto has role with @IsIn(['Admin','ProjectManager','Member'])
PATCH /api/users/:id/role prevents changing own role else throws ForbiddenException
PATCH /api/users/:id/role ensures target user tenant_id matches req.user.tenant_id else throws NotFoundException
controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports UsersModule

title: Projects Module
description: Enable project creation, listing, and archival with strict tenant isolation and role enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: ProjectsController exposes POST /api/projects with @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateProjectDto has name @IsString() @MaxLength(255) and optional description @MaxLength(1000)
POST /api/projects sets status to 'Active' and tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
ProjectsController exposes GET /api/projects?page=1&limit=20 accessible to any authenticated user
GET /api/projects filters by tenant_id and if role is 'Member' only returns projects where user is creator
GET /api/projects returns paginated response { data, meta }
ProjectsController exposes PATCH /api/projects/:id/archive with @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
PATCH /api/projects/:id/archive sets status to 'Archived' and prevents double archive
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports ProjectsModule

title: Tasks Module
description: Implement task creation, status updates, and listing within projects with role and ownership enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: TasksController exposes POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks with @Roles('Admin','ProjectManager')
CreateTaskDto has title @IsString() @MaxLength(255), optional description @MaxLength(1000), assignee_id @IsUUID()
POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks verifies project is 'Active' and belongs to tenant
POST /api/projects/:projectId/tasks sets status to 'ToDo' and tenant_id from req.user.tenant_id
TasksController exposes PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status
UpdateTaskStatusDto has status @IsIn(['ToDo','InProgress','Completed'])
PATCH /api/tasks/:id/status allows Admin any, ProjectManager within tenant, Member only if assignee_id === req.user.id else throws ForbiddenException
TasksController exposes GET /api/projects/:projectId/tasks?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/projects/:projectId/tasks returns paginated response { data, meta } and filters by tenant_id
All queries include .where('tenant_id', '=', req.user.tenant_id)
controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports TasksModule

title: Dashboard and Notifications Module
description: Provide aggregated dashboard metrics and user-specific notifications within tenant scope.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardController exposes GET /api/dashboard/summary accessible to authenticated users
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns { totalProjects, activeProjects, totalTasks, completedTasks } filtered by tenant_id
NotificationsController exposes GET /api/notifications?page=1&limit=20
GET /api/notifications returns { data: [], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All queries filter by tenant_id
controllers have NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports DashboardModule and NotificationsModule

title: Audit Logs Module
description: Record and expose tenant-scoped audit logs for critical actions with Admin-only access.
acceptance_criteria: AuditController exposes GET /api/audit-logs?page=1&limit=20 with @Roles('Admin')
GET /api/audit-logs returns { data: [], meta: { total, page, limit, totalPages } }
All audit log queries filter by tenant_id
controller has NO @UseGuards() decorator
app.module.ts imports AuditModule
